decision_criteria.rationale: Profile scope US compared with requested US.
Requested USD; supported currencies ['USD'].
Requested credit; supported directions ['credit', 'debit'].
Profile operation business-hours; customer requirement 24x7.
Institution access, contracted product and both actual endpoint locations/reach must be evidenced; public scheme access does not prove customer availability.
Native timing class scheduled; actual instruction cutoff/calendar and customer-delivery commitment require provider evidence.

The supplied currency-specific balance and free-text funding arrangement are declarations. Compatibility with the native settlement mechanism requires specialist review; neither text presence nor balance validates the funding model or grants access.
The future instruction requires explicit payer intent independently of authentication or request-for-payment receipt.
Native finality and return mechanisms remain distinct; consumer refund rights and operational return eligibility require separate review.
Actual contracted per-payment and fixed costs must be supplied; public fees and zero assumptions are not customer economics.

timing.notes: Batch and Same Day ACH options require applicable cutoffs, settlement date, SEC code and bank access.

profile_facts.finality: Settlement does not extinguish eligible returns; return rights depend on SEC, reason, consumer status and timing.
profile_facts.returns: Native ACH return/reversal processes; reversal is restricted error correction, not general refund.
profile_facts.funding: ODFI/RDFI settlement and customer funding under bank agreement.
profile_facts.access: Evidence of contracted participant/sponsor access and actual endpoint reachability required; listing a rail does not prove access.
limitations: Design profile only; not operating authority, legal applicability or production certification.
No universal amount limit, fee, customer cutoff or return deadline is inferred.
